items.difficulty_reason: 31 行、标准局部-整体 + 模层面归纳：①Mayer-Vietoris for Hom 沿开集粘合命题（对 f|_U、f|_V、f|_{U∩V} 成立 ⇒ 对 f 成立），induction principle 归到仿射；②仿射上用 affine-compare + perfect-affine 把 E 写成有限投射模有界复形 P^bullet；③ stupid 截断三角 P^t[-t] → P^bullet → σ_{≤t-1} 对复形长度归纳，shift 去掉次数，归到单个有限投射模 P（degree 0）、α 成为 P → H^0(M^bullet)；④支撑在 V(f) 的模的元素被 f 的幂零杀，P 有限 ⇒ 单个 n 同时杀掉所有像 ⇒ f^n α = 0。承重全在 span 内；4 处引用（2 同章、2 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-perfect-into-support-on-T (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3643-3654

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the gluing of the assertion over opens by Mayer-Vietoris for Hom and reduction to the affine case by the induction principle, the affine case where E is represented by a bounded complex of finite projective modules reduced term by term to a single finite projective module, and the module-level annihilation since the target cohomology module is supported on V(f) (source lines 3656-3686)
